sessions.title: Strength & mobility
sessions.detail: About 30 min. Work down the list in order, resting about a minute between sets, then finish with 5 min of mobility.
sessions.purpose: Stronger legs and hips hold your form late in a race and help keep injuries away.

sessions.title: Hill repeats
sessions.detail: Warm up, then 6 × 60 s uphill at a hard but controlled effort. Jog back down to recover.
sessions.purpose: Builds strength and running form before the faster work starts.

sessions.title: Easy run + strides
sessions.detail: Easy running, then 6 × 20 s strides: quick and relaxed, walk back between each.
sessions.purpose: Keeps your legs quick without adding fatigue.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.detail: Conversational effort. You should be able to talk in full sentences.
sessions.purpose: Most of your fitness is built here, at very little cost.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.detail: Steady and relaxed the whole way. Walk breaks are fine.
sessions.purpose: Builds the endurance that carries you to the finish.

sessions.detail: 5 km. Start at goal pace, not faster, and save something for the second half.
sessions.purpose: This is what every run in the plan was for. Enjoy it.
